addr: 8, 80 Feet Rd, HAL 3rd Stage, Colony New 515, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, India

rev.t: Amazing co-working space and work from anywhere feature is simply superb I love it sometimes I have to workout from Indiranagar this feature has made it simple to access other properties without buying day pass.
Booked this place for two weeks, place is good for work, coffee and tea is unlimited available, private cabin and conference room are also available overall experience was good.
I am someone who keeps traveling to Bangalore pretty often, and HoneyKomb was a very good place for me to get some focused work going. Thanks Mridul for being a wonderful host. …
